method: Per state: read the agency's own full campground roster (not a sample), diff facility by facility against DB state entries, add every real RV campground absent - closed ones with a dated caveat. Check secondary categories (state forests, SRAs, wildlife-area campgrounds) as well as the flagship parks.

TN.source: tnstateparks.com/parks/<slug>/camping for every park in the nav (40 with a camping page)
excluded: Frozen Head - Big Cove

closed; agency says 'best suited for small RVs', primitive; access bridge reported (Roadtrippers) at a 5-ton (10,000 lb) limit. EKKO weighs ~9,500 lb empty and has an 11,000 lb GVWR (AWH 2026-09-29), so a loaded EKKO exceeds it -> excluded
David Crockett Birthplace
campground destroyed in the 2024 Helene flood; park no longer lists any camping page - no live presence
NBF Lakefront, Mousetail Spring Creek, Fall Creek Falls Area C primitive
primitive areas inside parks already held; not separate RV campgrounds worth an entry
Cumberland Trail, Savage Gulf, Scott's Gulf, Rocky Fork, North Chickamauga, Long Hunter
backcountry / hike-in only
TN.not_checked: TN state forests and TWRA WMA camping (secondary categories)

NY.source: DEC 2026 Summer Recreation Campground Summary PDF (every DEC campground) + parks.ny.gov state-park directory filtered to 'Campsites, Cabins & Lodging' (73 parks); size gate from each ReserveAmerica site catalog (campsitePaging.do + campsiteDetails.do, 'Max Vehicle Length')
added: 100+ free roadside sites; east end closed by bridge failure
excluded: Forked Lake (DEC)
walk-in/boat-in except 3 sites that take 20-ft RVs
Indian Lake Islands, Tioga Point, Saranac Lake Islands, Alger Island, Lake George Islands (Glen/Long/Narrow Island) (DEC)
boat-in
Buttermilk Falls, Lake Taghkanic, Taconic Rudd Pond, DeWolf Point (OPRHP)
every RV site in the ReserveAmerica catalog is capped at 20 ft (checked NY's lengths are real, not a default: Fahnestock 15-30, Green Lakes to 60)
Canoe-Picnic Point, Cedar Island, Mary Island (OPRHP)
boat-in only
Bear Mountain, Betty & Wilbur Davis, Long Point (Finger Lakes), Robert G. Wehle, Saratoga Spa, Sebago Cabin Camp (OPRHP)
lodging/cabins/cottage only
NY.not_checked: DEC state-forest primitive camping beyond Moose River Plains (dispersed; not hunted)

OR.source: Oregon State Parks ReserveAmerica directory (66 parks, campgroundDirectoryList.do, carries coords) diffed by name+distance; the 16 unmatched pulled via audit/ra_site_catalog.py; ODF camp.aspx + Clatsop/Santiam/Tillamook recreation-guide PDFs
excluded: OPRD unmatched (Benson, Dabney, Elijah Bristow, Guy Talbot, Hat Rock, Illinois River Forks, Jasper, Lowell, Maud Williamson, Molalla River, Rooster Rock, Sarah Helmick, Smith Rock, TouVelle)
day-use/shelter reservations only in the RA catalog
Willamette Mission SP, Northrup Creek, Reehers Camp, Santiam, Stagecoach
horse camps (Reehers: 10 horse / 7 non-horse, 'primarily for horse campers')
Browns Camp, Diamond Mill, Jordan Creek (Tillamook), Viewpoint (Clatsop)
ODF OHV camps: 'Designated for campers with trail-ready OHVs. Campers without OHVs will be required to leave.'
Elk Creek, Keenig Creek, Morrison Eddy (Tillamook), Gnat Creek, Beaver Eddy (Clatsop)
walk-in tent only
Shellburg Falls (Santiam)
4 drive-in sites, no stated size, ~5 mi gravel described as high-clearance, 2020 fire damage may not be rebuilt - can't confirm fit
ODF designated campsites (Cedar Creek etc.), Rock Creek, High Lakes
dispersed/primitive roadside, not hunted
OR.note: OPRD flagship coverage was already complete; RA directory coords are sometimes admin pins (Clyde Holliday, Unity Lake, Prineville main) - the DB pins are right

MO.source: Missouri State Parks US eDirect portal (msprdr.usedirect.com/MSPRDR, added to audit/state_gap_portal.py as --portal mo): 93 parks, 78 camping facilities already held; mostateparks.com/activity/camping list
fixed: Graham Cave SP pin moved 450 m from the park building onto the campground loop
Berry Bend: pin checked against rec.gov per-site coords - correct, no change
excluded: Taum Sauk Mountain SP
12 walk-in sites, tent only - 'Pop-up or other trailers are not allowed'
Prairie SP
a few basic group sites + backpack camp, no RV confirmation
Viney Creek Recreation Area (Table Rock Lake, Golden)
Corps campground MSP stopped operating after 2019 (lost money); stale portal listing with a Bootheel pin; no current operator found
MO.open: MDC conservation areas: 263 areas carry 'Designated Camping Sites' (156) and/or 'Individual Campsites' (133) in MDC's area search (mo/mdc_camp list in session scratch); DB holds 4 (1930-1933, all ownership state). Scope decision pending with AWH.
